description: Source file for image handling in the Battle for Wesnoth project, including image caching, loading, transformations, and minimap generation.

classes.name: image::locator
classes.description: Handles image file locations and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: image::manager
classes.description: Manages image cache and global image settings.

methods.name: image::flush_cache
methods.description: Clears all image caches and internal maps.

methods.name: image::locator::load_image_file
methods.description: Loads an image from disk based on locator data.

methods.name: image::locator::load_image_sub_file
methods.description: Loads a sub-region of an image based on locator data.

methods.name: image::locator::load_from_disk
methods.description: Loads image depending on locator type.

methods.name: image::get_image
methods.description: Retrieves an image in specified format and applies adjustments.

methods.name: image::get_unmasked
methods.description: Returns an unmasked version of the image.

methods.name: image::get_scaled
methods.description: Returns a scaled version of the image.

methods.name: image::get_greyed
methods.description: Returns a greyscale version of the image.

methods.name: image::get_brightened
methods.description: Returns a brightened version of the image.

methods.name: image::get_semi_brightened
methods.description: Returns a semi-brightened version of the image.

methods.name: image::get_image_dim
methods.description: Returns an image scaled to specific dimensions.

methods.name: image::reverse_image
methods.description: Returns a horizontally flipped version of the image.

methods.name: image::exists
methods.description: Checks if an image exists in cache or disk.

methods.name: image::getMinimap
methods.description: Generates a minimap surface from the game map.
